shared_art_direction: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished in-game space background matte for a top-down mobile sci-fi MOBA, Dimensions Front. ONE coherent wide landscape image, 2:1 aspect ratio, edge-to-edge. Premium detailed astronomical matte painting with physically plausible space light, intricate nebula dust filaments, crisp tiny stars, sophisticated restrained palette and visual depth. A calm dark central area must stay readable behind a floating arena; put the distinctive large celestial shapes toward the lower sides and outer frame. NOT an equirectangular image: this is a camera-facing cinematic wide background. The image will be cropped to different landscape phone screens, so keep the main planetary feature within the middle 80% of the width and avoid important content at the extreme edge. No UI, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no border, no characters, no foreground terrain, no buildings, no spaceships, no collage, no baked shooting stars or bright streaks. Keep peak lights localized and the overall space dark, never a flat colorful wash.

Add delicate extra moonlets near the large planets, denser fine star fields and recognizable star clusters across the whole image, including the center. Keep layered depth and photographic astronomical detail, not a diagram or collage. UI readability still matters: planet surfaces mostly dark, brightest rims and nebula patches localized, medium-dark calm contrast behind future interface text. No text or interface in the actual image. No flares obscuring the scene, no spaceships, characters, buildings, terrain, borders or watermarks. No baked shooting-star streaks because those are animated separately. Preserve the existing nebula craftsmanship but change the layout substantially to satisfy the fuller multi-planet request.
